# Pi API Contract Registry — llms.txt
# A read-only, dated record of measured Soroban RPC behaviour on Pi Network,
# with wire types, drift entries, and live conformance re-measurement.

> API documentation says what a method SHOULD return. This registry records what
> the endpoint DID return, on a dated run at a stated version, and lists where a
> client trusting the documentation will break.

## What it is
- read-only, zero-dependency, Node (ESM)
- pure data: lib.mjs (registry, scope, methods, wire types, drift, checks)
- engine: conformance.mjs (evaluate, summarise, decide publishability)
- render: render.mjs (registry, drift, boundaries)
- CLI: registry-cli.mjs

## Three concepts, kept apart
- documented contract  what a published specification says
- measured contract    what this endpoint actually returned, dated, versioned
- drift                where measured departs from client expectation

## Three scopes (NO universal scope exists)
- endpoint-scoped | version-scoped | protocol-scoped

## Wire types are recorded as the wire spells them
- getHealth.latestLedgerCloseTime is a STRING (Unix seconds as text)
- getFeeStats figures are STRINGS ("100000") while ledgerCount is a NUMBER
- getTransaction.events is an OBJECT ({}) on NOT_FOUND, an ARRAY on success

## Recorded scope (measured 2026-10-19)
- endpoint: https://rpc.testnet.minepi.com
- passphrase: "Pi Testnet"
- node: 28.0.1  protocol: 28
- methods: 10 (9 supported, 1 absent)
- drift entries: 9 (3 high, 4 medium, 2 low)
- retention window: 120960 ledgers (matches pi-soroban-events)
- mainnet: NOT REACHABLE (HTTP 503)

## Drift (observed vs expected)
- D-SIM-1 high  simulateTransaction: a failure is NOT a JSON-RPC error; HTTP 200,
  message inside result.error
- D-TX-1  high  getTransaction: result.events type depends on status
- D-CON-1 high  getContractData: absent here (-32601); use getLedgerEntries
- D-FEE-1 med   getFeeStats: numeric figures returned as strings
- D-EVT-1 med   getEvents: two timestamp encodings on one endpoint
- D-ENT-1 med   getLedgerEntries: empty key list is -32603, not empty result
- D-TX-2  med   getTransaction: NOT_FOUND inside a success envelope
- D-VER-1 low   getVersionInfo: buildTimestamp has no timezone
- D-FEE-2 low   getFeeStats: two fee objects cover different ledger counts

## Conformance: three verdicts, never conflated
- pass   the live endpoint still matches the recorded row
- fail   the endpoint MOVED; the row is stale and must be updated
- error  the check could not be evaluated; NO conclusion either way
- publishable is true ONLY when every check passed
- exit 0 all pass | 1 any fail | 2 any error

## Usage
- node registry-cli.mjs --registry [--json]
- node registry-cli.mjs --drift
- node registry-cli.mjs --conformance [--json]
- node registry-cli.mjs --boundaries | --help
- --rpc <url>   override the endpoint (only for --conformance)

## Not claimed
- that this is the official or authoritative API reference
- that any row will still hold tomorrow
- that a row holds at another endpoint or version
- that an observed departure is a bug (drift is recorded, not judged)
- that a pass covers methods or fields not in the check list
- that an error is a fail
- anything about Mainnet
- that Pi Network has adopted, reviewed, or endorsed this
